notes: Unofficial requirement checklist, not the official course score.
Only category=requirements earns base points; consistency and intent are unscored feedback.
Freeze this rubric and bonus policy across the cohort; do not create scored items from individual submissions.
Criterion IDs are stable identifiers; their prefixes do not determine scoring.

items.title: 보고서·PR·실제 구현의 일치
items.rule: Check aggregates and per-episode table, claims about code behavior, source versions and any explained re-scoring; do not infer dishonesty from a mismatch. Review all material claims, including optional work, without assigning points or creating new scored items.
items.pass_rule: Main experimental results, calculations and implementation descriptions agree. Explained historical re-scoring is permitted. Local wording errors that do not change the main results can receive revision feedback while this item passes.
items.fail_rule: Unexplained contradictions materially change reported results, reproducibility or the central conclusion. Do not fail for a local phrasing error or one corrected metric-source description alone.

items.title: 관측 범위·실패·한계 해석
items.rule: Do not overgeneralize small samples or unobserved intent; separate diagnostic tests, pilots, failures and main experiment. Honest negative findings are valid.
items.pass_rule: Central conclusions stay within observed evidence, and major scope limits/failed attempts are disclosed. A local overstatement may need revision without failing the criterion when the main conclusion remains supported.
items.fail_rule: The central conclusion rests on unsupported causal/general claims or concealed material limitations. Explain its consequence; do not fail merely because one sentence needs softer wording.
